P5B_four_way_adjudication.explanation: The frozen v3 P5B package contains mixed LF/CRLF-dependent self-hash expectations. With core.autocrlf=true, its protected P5A contract is checked out as CRLF although its stored expected hash is LF. Canonical LF materialization resolves that item but exposes other pre-existing hashes that were frozen from CRLF bytes. No v3 P5B file was modified in v6.0.0.

release_interpretation: The v6 SQLite extension and its retained evidence pass their frozen checks. The inherited v3 P5B cross-platform self-hash limitation is disclosed rather than repaired by altering frozen evidence.
